title: document intake into brief statements
description: A submitted document reaches the brief ledger as kinded statements with source spans through `brief add --from`, the intake scans run over the new statements against the existing ones, and every finding becomes an open question the loop asks.
rationale: Spec 2026-10-01 (DEFINE step 3) section 2.1 splits intake into two halves. The harness writes a statement file beside each source and the operator corrects it. rcf-lite mints the statements, runs the intake scans over the new statements against the existing ones, and appends one openQuestion statement per finding. This is the seam decision 4 pins down: scan findings become brief statements so the loop reads one check (brief:openQuestions) and the owner answers in one place.
